ai_summary: Adani Power Limited reported robust Q2 FY27 financial performance, showcasing strong growth in continuing revenue and EBITDA due to higher dispatch volumes and improved realizations across PPAs and merchant sales. A significant material impact on reported results was a substantial one-time revenue recognition of ₹2,422 crore, which dramatically boosted the reported 141.5% PAT increase, highlighting the distinction between recurring and non-recurring gains. Despite this, the company maintains healthy leverage, positive credit ratings, and an aggressive long-term capacity expansion strategy across thermal, hydro, and nuclear power.
